title: "APD trait browser"
format:
  html:
    page-layout: full
    toc: false

The APD trait browser lets you explore the traits in the AusTraits Plant Dictionary (APD) by trait
group, read each trait's definition, and find related traits that share a facet. It is embedded
below, or you can

<p>
<a class="btn-primary" href="https://traitecoevo.github.io/APD/trait_browser.html" target="_blank" rel="noopener"><i class="bi bi-box-arrow-up-right"></i> Open the trait browser in a new tab</a>
</p>

```{=html}
<div style="position: relative; width: 100%; height: 80vh; min-height: 600px; border: 1px solid #ddd; border-radius: 6px; overflow: hidden; margin-top: 1rem;">
  <iframe
    src="https://traitecoevo.github.io/APD/trait_browser.html"
    title="APD trait browser"
    loading="lazy"
    allowfullscreen
    style="width: 100%; height: 100%; border: none;">
  </iframe>
</div>
```

::: {.callout-note appearance="simple"}
The trait browser is part of the APD site at
[traitecoevo.github.io/APD](https://traitecoevo.github.io/APD/). The APD itself, with its source,
is at [w3id.org/APD](https://w3id.org/APD) and
[`traitecoevo/APD`](https://github.com/traitecoevo/APD).
:::
